cutoff_note: Proposed >=96h after Stage-0 sealing per GATE2-V2 §7; if Stage-0 artifact review outlasts it, the cutoff is re-sealed before Stage-1 authorization, never reused stale.
clock_rule: The snapshot runner's UTC system clock is compared against the GraphQL response's Date header and each commit's committedDate envelope; absolute skew beyond max_clock_skew_seconds is a deterministic stop.
request_rule: One non-paginated request, fired automatically at the cutoff instant; any transport failure, partial body, schema surprise, moved/renamed repository, or skew violation stops the round; no retry without a newly reviewed cutoff.
not_fired: Stage 0 seals this package only; the request itself is Stage 1 and requires separate authorization.
